item.sophisticated_backpacks_digital_sto: Use the button to deposit filtered items from the backpack into the linked network.
Use the button to move filtered items from the linked network into the backpack.
Automatically send collected items that match the filters to the linked network or backpack.
Collect nearby item drops that match the filters and send them to the linked network or backpack.
Automatically refill selected player inventory slots with items from the linked network or backpack.
Automatically feed the player carrying this backpack with filtered food when hungry (or when hurt, if enabled), using the linked network or backpack.
Automatically use configured consumables on the player carrying this backpack when the conditions are met. Items come from the linked network or backpack.
Transfer filtered fluids between the linked AE2/RS network or backpack tank and containers, nearby blocks that accept fluids, or world fluids. Tom's Simple Storage does not support fluid transfers.
